text:
maya: Hey team, first week here - I can log into the console but Grafana only shows a bunch of empty panels for me. Datadog dashboards load but some monitors say "no access". Who do I ping to get the right observability access? :wave:
onboarding-bot: Welcome to Redwood, maya! Please post your email and the apps you need access to (Grafana / Datadog / Sentry). Someone from #devex or #eng-sre will help. :tada:
jim: @maya - welcome! Usually this is an Okta group mapping issue. Can you confirm your Redwood email? Also which dashboards are missing (links help).
maya: maya@redwood.com. Missing dashboards: infra overview and model-serving latency. Grafana link: <https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/infra-overview> - panels show "no data" and some say "requires role: observability:viewer"
alex: @maya I can add you to the group `infra-observability` which maps to Grafana / Datadog viewer roles. Give me ~10m. For Sentry, we use `sentry-read` group. Do you need to file issues or just dashboards/alerts?
maya: Mostly dashboards and alert visibility. Might want to subscribe to a few SLO alerts.
lisa: fyi, if you want to subscribe to alerts in Datadog you need the `monitor_read` role or be in the team watchlist. If alex adds you to `infra-observability` that should cover everything except Sentry which alex can add separately.
alex: Added you to `infra-observability`. You might need to sign out and back into Okta for the group to show. If Grafana still blanks, check this quick list:
```
1) Sign out of Okta
2) Sign back in via https://okta.redwood.example
3) Visit Grafana link and click Refresh
4) If panels still blank, ping me with the panel IDs
```
maya: signed out+in, refreshed, infra dashboard now visible! :raised_hands: Datadog monitors still show "no access" for two monitors: `deployment-failures` and `gpu-queue-latency`.
jim: For Datadog we sometimes need to add you to the monitor's team watchlist - I'll add your email to the watchlist for `deployment-failures`. @alex can you grant `monitor_read` for `gpu` dashboards to `infra-observability`?
alex: done for `gpu` dashboards. jim, I can't edit that monitor (owner is platform-ci). maya, you should now see the monitors, give it another refresh.
maya: I can see `deployment-failures` monitor now but the GPU monitor still shows restricted.
lisa: platform-ci team owns that monitor - cc @platform-ci. If you need long-term access we can request they add `infra-observability` as a watcher. For a quick workaround, I can invite maya directly to Datadog with `monitor_read` for 24h. OK?
maya: that would be perfect, thanks.
platform-ci: Added maya@redwood.com as a viewer on that monitor for 30d. Also updated monitor mute/notify list as requested.
maya: Sentry access - I tried to open the errors page and it redirected me to request access. What should I ask for?
jim: Ask for `sentry-read` via Okta app. If you can't request through Okta, file a quick ticket to infra-accounts with subject: "Sentry access for maya@redwood.com - read" and link to which projects you need. Example text: "Please add maya@redwood.com to `sentry-read` for projects: redwood-inference, model-serving"
maya: filed infra-accounts ticket. Ticket #1234.
alex: Quick tip for dashboards - if you want a curated list for first week, check the onboarding folder: <https://grafana.redwood.example/d/onboarding/list>. It has panels and a short explainer for each metric (what to watch, acceptable thresholds).
maya: This is super helpful, thanks everyone. One last Q: how do I subscribe to the SLA alerts for model-serving?
lisa: Go to the Datadog monitor, click "Notify" then "Add email" or add your user to the monitor's notification list. If you prefer, tell me which monitors and I'll add you.
maya: Can you add me to `model-serving-latency` and `model-serving-error-rate` monitors?
lisa: Added you to both. You should get a test notification in ~2m.
maya: Received test notification. All set. Thanks all! :heart:
